pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify Past Chat Information Before Stating Specific Details
lesson.when: A customer asks to recall or repeat product details or quotes from past conversations, but official record sources do not contain evidence of that past interaction
lesson.do: State clearly that the past chat details cannot be confirmed or retrieved, and ask the customer to clarify what item they need assistance with
lesson.otherwise: Express uncertainty about being unable to check past records; do not state unverified specific product codes or prior recommendations
triggers: xác nhận giá đã báo trong chat
